name: Invention of Basketball
description: Basketball is invented by Dr. James Naismith in Springfield, Massachusetts.

name: First Basketball Game
description: The first basketball game is played with nine players on each team.

name: Formation of First Basketball League
description: The National Basketball League (NBL) is established as the first professional basketball league.

name: First NBA Game
description: The first ever NBA game is played between the New York Knicks and the Toronto Huskies.

name: Introduction of 24-Second Shot Clock
description: The 24-second shot clock is introduced to speed up the pace of the game.

name: Wilt Chamberlain's 100-Point Game
description: Wilt Chamberlain scores a record-breaking 100 points in a single game.

name: ABA-NBA Merger
description: The American Basketball Association (ABA) merges with the National Basketball Association (NBA).

name: Magic Johnson vs. Larry Bird Rivalry
description: Magic Johnson and Larry Bird dominate the NBA and their rivalry becomes iconic.

name: Michael Jordan's NBA Debut
description: Michael Jordan makes his NBA debut with the Chicago Bulls.

name: Dream Team at the Barcelona Olympics
description: The United States men's basketball team, featuring NBA superstars, wins gold at the Barcelona Olympics.

name: Allen Iverson's Crossover
description: Allen Iverson's iconic crossover move becomes legendary.

name: Kobe Bryant's 81-Point Game
description: Kobe Bryant scores 81 points in a single game, the second-highest scoring performance in NBA history.

name: LeBron James' Decision
description: LeBron James announces his decision to join the Miami Heat in a televised special, sparking controversy.

name: Golden State Warriors' Record-Breaking Season
description: The Golden State Warriors break the record for most wins in a regular season with 73 victories.

name: Stephen Curry's Unanimous MVP Award
description: Stephen Curry becomes the first player in NBA history to win the MVP award unanimously.

name: Kevin Durant Joins the Golden State Warriors
description: Kevin Durant shocks the basketball world by signing with the Golden State Warriors.

name: Kawhi Leonard's Buzzer-Beater
description: Kawhi Leonard hits a miraculous buzzer-beating shot in Game 7 of the NBA Playoffs against the Philadelphia 76ers.

name: Bubble Experiment in NBA
description: The NBA successfully creates a bubble environment to resume the season amidst the COVID-19 pandemic.

name: NBA All-Star Game Tribute to Kobe Bryant
description: The NBA All-Star Game pays tribute to Kobe Bryant, who tragically passed away earlier that year.

name: Los Angeles Lakers Win NBA Championship
description: The Los Angeles Lakers win their 17th NBA championship, tying the Boston Celtics for most championships in history.

name: Formation of WNBA
description: The Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) is established as the premier professional women's basketball league.

name: Lisa Leslie Becomes First Woman to Dunk in WNBA
description: Lisa Leslie becomes the first woman to dunk in a WNBA game.

name: Diana Taurasi Becomes WNBA All-Time Leading Scorer
description: Diana Taurasi surpasses Tina Thompson as the WNBA's all-time leading scorer.

name: Breanna Stewart Wins WNBA MVP, Finals MVP, and Olympic Gold
description: Breanna Stewart has a historic year, winning both the WNBA MVP and Finals MVP awards, as well as an Olympic gold medal.

name: Sue Bird Becomes WNBA All-Time Assists Leader
description: Sue Bird surpasses Ticha Penicheiro as the WNBA's all-time assists leader.

name: Basketball's Inclusion in the Olympics
description: Basketball is included as an official Olympic sport for the first time.

name: United States Men's Basketball Team Loses in Olympic Finals
description: The United States men's basketball team suffers its first Olympic finals loss to the Soviet Union.
